members.name: Big Banana
members.bio: Opened in 1964 as Australia's original Big Thing, a giant banana beside a fun park, cafe and gift shop.
members.hours: Daily from 9:00 AM; closed Christmas Day

members.name: Muttonbird Island
members.bio: Nature-reserve island reached by a breakwall, where wedge-tailed shearwaters nest from about November.

members.name: Park Beach
members.bio: The main surf beach in Coffs, just north of the Coffs Creek mouth, where swimming can be rough.

members.name: Bongil Bongil National Park
members.bio: Coastal park near Coffs Harbour with one of NSW's largest koala populations, for walking, paddling and fishing.

members.name: Woolgoolga
members.bio: Relaxed coastal town nicknamed 'Woopi', with long sandy beaches and a strong Sikh heritage.

members.name: Guru Nanak Sikh Temple
members.bio: One of regional Australia's largest Sikh temples, open to visitors with shoes off and head covered inside.

members.name: Woolgoolga Beach
members.bio: Wide, clean beach below a headland with views up and down the coast, best at sunrise.

members.name: Arrawarra Beach
members.bio: Quiet beach just north of Woolgoolga, known for uncrowded sand and consistent surf.
members.photo_file: Arrawarra Beach close to the Ocean.jpg

members.name: Coffs Coast Wildlife Sanctuary
members.bio: Not-for-profit rescue and release sanctuary on Orlando Street with dolphins, penguins, sea lions and turtles.

members.name: Sea Acres National Park
members.bio: Coastal rainforest with a 1.3 km boardwalk loop from the Rainforest Centre and ranger-led Aboriginal culture tours.
members.photo_file: Coastline of Sea Acres National Park, Port Macquarie NSW.JPG

members.name: Tacking Point Lighthouse
members.bio: An 1879 lighthouse reserve with 180-degree ocean views, whale-watching lookouts and an accessible walkway.

members.name: Port Macquarie Coastal Walk
members.bio: A 9 km one-way coastal walk linking Westport Park, beaches and headlands to Tacking Point Lighthouse.
members.photo_file: The Mudslide from Nobbys Hill - panoramio.jpg

members.name: Flynns Beach
members.bio: Resort-precinct surf beach with summer patrols, Norfolk pine shade and a cafe.

members.name: Town Beach
members.bio: Port Macquarie's most central beach, with a patrolled, family-friendly south end and a beachfront cafe.

members.name: Roto House
members.bio: An 1891 red-mahogany house of 11 rooms built by surveyor John Flynn, with picnic lawns and a cafe.

members.name: Billabong Zoo
members.bio: Koala and wildlife park of more than 80 species and 200 animals, with free zoo talks through the day.
members.photo_file: The Big Koala Family at Billabong Zoo Port Macquarie.jpg

members.name: Skywalk
members.bio: Elevated lookout in Dorrigo National Park with views over rainforest and the Bellinger Valley to the coast.

members.name: Wonga Walk
members.bio: A 5.8 km rainforest loop past Tristania and Crystal Shower falls, allow two to three hours.
members.hours: Daylight; visitor centre 9 AM – 4:30 PM (to 3:30 PM Jun–Aug)
members.photo_file: Crystal Shower Falls in Dorrigo National Park.jpg

members.name: Dangar Falls
members.bio: A 30 m cascade across the Bielsdown River 1.2 km north of Dorrigo, a popular photography spot.

members.name: Dorrigo
members.bio: Small plateau town on Waterfall Way, 30 minutes from Bellingen and an hour from Coffs Harbour.

members.name: Bellingen
members.bio: Pretty arts-and-crafts town of about 13,000 in a green valley, with a Waterfall Way visitor centre.

members.name: Trial Bay Gaol
members.bio: Ruined 1886 gaol built to house labourers on a breakwater, now with a museum, in Arakoon National Park.
members.photo_file: The main entrance to the Trial Bay Gaol - Taken on the Wednesday, 18th August 2010 at 1-21pm. - panoramio.jpg

members.name: Smoky Cape Lighthouse
members.bio: 1891 lighthouse 111 m above the sea, the highest lighthouse light in NSW, with ranger-led tours.
members.hours: Open 24 hours (park may close for weather or fire)
members.photo_file: Smoky Cape Lighthouse on a beautiful clear day.jpg

members.name: Arakoon National Park
members.bio: Park around Trial Bay with beachside camping, rocky fishing shores, swimming beaches and July-August whale watching.

members.name: Hat Head National Park
members.bio: Beaches, dunes, rainforest and wetlands near South West Rocks, with beach camping.
members.photo_file: Overlook of Hat Head National Park.jpg

members.name: Booti Booti National Park
members.bio: Peninsula between ocean and Wallis Lake with beaches, rainforest, an 8 km loop walk and winter whales.

members.name: Cape Hawke Lookout
members.bio: A 500 m rainforest climb of about 420 steps to an 8.4 m tower with coast views and whale watching.

members.name: Bennetts Head Lookout
members.bio: Wheelchair-accessible headland lookout in Forster, a whale-watching post from May to November.
members.photo_file: View from Bennett's Head Lookout - panoramio.jpg

members.name: Boomerang Beach
members.bio: Boomerang-shaped beach with rock-ledge waves, rock pools at low tide and the Pacific Palms area's best surf.
members.photo_file: Rock Layers in Cliff at Boomerang Beach in NSW in Australia.jpg

members.name: Blueys Beach
members.bio: Long, shallow beach with a headland view to Seal Rocks, beside a village of cafes and a visitor centre.

members.name: Elizabeth Beach
members.bio: Calm north-facing family beach patrolled in summer, where the Booti walking track starts.
members.photo_file: Elizabeth Beach in the late afternoon - panoramio.jpg

members.name: Diamond Beach
members.bio: Six-kilometre beach between Taree and Forster for fishing, surfing and long walks, with dolphins often offshore.
members.photo_file: Diamond Beach from Diamond Beach Lookout.jpg
